item.title: Longford and Leitrim get Ladies football season off the ground
item.description: An intriguing fixture lies in store as Longford prepare to entertain Leitrim in Sunday’s live game. Longford finished third from bottom last year while Leitrim reached the semi-finals, where they lost out to Antrim. Leitrim will be one of the promotion favourites but they won’t get anything easy on their visit to the Midlands. item.description: Sligo produced a late comeback to down Roscommon and land the FBD League sheild. item.title: Key Vote Next Week on Referring Mercosur Trade Deal to EU Court
item.description: An important vote on whether to refer the Mercosur Trade Deal to the European Court of Justice will take place next week. It comes after over 100 MEPs proposed a legal review of the agreement. The deal, passed by MEPs earlier this month, would see a hundred thousand tonnes of South American beef gain access to European markets. item.title: Over 260 Commencement Notices Issued Across Shannonside Region in 2025
item.description: The Shannonside region issued Over 260 Commencement Notices in 2025. That's one of the findings from the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage, which has published its monthly figures. A Commencement Notice is a notification to a Building Control Authority that a person intends to carry out works or a Material Change of Use under the Building Regulations. item.title: Local counties to be paired with member states during EU presidency
item.description: Counties across the Shannonside region will be paired with member states during Ireland's Presidency of the European Union. Minister for Foreign Affairs Helen McEntee announced the details, which aim to engage communities across the country on Ireland's European relationships. Starting from July, counties Longford, Roscommon, and Leitrim will be paired with Hungary, Cyprus, Slovenia respectively. item.title: Almost €950,000 in Arts Funding Announced for Shannonside Region
item.description: Almost €950,000 worth of funding was announced this week for arts organisations, arts centres and local authorities in the Shannonside region. The funding represents more than half of the Arts Council's annual investment. Longford received the largest allocation locally, with €433,000 going to various groups.
